title: First zero after the leading ones
statement: Let $c$ be a finite Boolean word containing at least one $0$, and let $r$ be the number of its initial consecutive $1$'s. Then $c$ is the concatenation of $r$ copies of $1$, followed by $0$, followed by the suffix of $c$ after those first $r+1$ entries.
